key_points: Headlines are overwhelmingly analytical/routine: macro data previews, ETF flow reports, 52-week high/low lists
No earnings surprises, guidance changes, regulatory events, M&A, or major product news for SPY or key constituents
Midterm election outcome (Democratic sweep) mentioned but framed as speculative analysis, not confirmed market-moving news
ETF buying of mega-caps (NVDA, AAPL, MSFT) reflects routine index rebalancing/flows, not new fundamental catalysts
Long-term thesis for broad market ETF unchanged by daily macro commentary and flow data
